page.layout: One page of verse, one column; running head at top; page number at top right; catchword "Placa" at the foot right.

main_text.p:
Per quod Ave salutata,
Mox concepit fœcundata,
Virgo, David stirpe nata,
Inter spinas lilium.

Ave veri Salomonis
Madens vellus Gedeonis,
Cujus Magi tribus donis
Laudant puerperium.

Ave sponsa verbi summi,
Maris partus, signum dumi,
Aromatum virga fumi,
Angelorum domina.

Ave, solem genuisti,
Ave, prolem protulisti,
Mundo lapso contulisti
Vitam & imperium.

Supplicamus, nos emenda,
Emendatos nos commenda
Tuo nato, ad habenda
Sempiterna gaudia, Amen.

Omnis homo, omni horā,
Hanc adora, ac implora
Ejus patrocinia.

Psalle, psalle nisu toto
Cordis, oris, voce, voto.
Ave, plena gratiā.

Salve decus firmamenti,
Tu caliginosæ menti
Desuper irradia,

page.notes:
The page is faded; some letters at the edges, such as in "Psalle" and "Cordis", are doubtful. The catchword "Placa" is printed at the lower right. The line "Placa" may be a catchword and is marked here as such in the layout; the final

duplicates it and should be read as the catchword only.
